zmij 1.0.23
Upstream: https://github.com/dtolnay/zmij
Revision: 7b7cc48b58028e8af7be87e94c0c1c8936f1a57c
Crate SHA-256: 29666d0abbfad1e3dc4dcf6144730dd3a3ab225bbbdac83319345b1b44ccfc1b
License: MIT. See LICENSE-MIT.

Kiwix changes: keep the upstream binary-to-decimal conversion and rounding
rules. Use checked power-table indexing, scalar digit assembly and initialized
stack storage. Keep the compressed table selection for size-optimized builds.
The library forbids unsafe Rust. The private fork omits the optional no-panic
instrumentation, which is unused in the app and relay.
